notes.title: Change of direction of the project
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I have an announcement to make regarding this project :

After many thoughts and consultations with certain knowledge versed in the field of Video Games, I see myself forced to change my plans for the development of If you win... You lose!

It was initially planned to make the game pay with a sustained rate of content updates in "game as a service".

However, given what I have been advised and taking a step back on the current state of my skills, it seems that I am somewhat misguided. I acted hastily but I currently have neither the technical means nor the financial means to carry out such a project. 

The complexity of its design also makes me exhausted and the motivation is no longer that of the first days.

The game will therefore remain completely free, and this, in a definitive way.

I apologize for getting a little carried away and making promises I couldn't keep. I was not aware of it, we can put it down to inexperience, project management is so much more complicated than it seems at first glance...

I sincerely thank everyone who supported the project, and also the others who hated it for at least testing my game and taking the time to express their opinion on it  :) 

See you soon for another project with more solid foundations than this one! In the meantime, I wish you an excellent continuation.

Also note that I am not a basic graphic designer and that I do not yet master computer graphics well enough, so sorry I cannot correct the faults and graphic deficiencies for the moment.

Cordially.

Mohammad Trigui.

notes.title: good news
notes.content:
Good evening everyone ,

In fact, after yet another great reflection I realized that I was wrong and I rushed very quickly during the previous announcement for two reasons:

- a large part of you are in principle still busy at the moment for various reasons (such as exams etc) it is not okay to give a very early date like that in this case, sorry so much.

-As some have said, this is not the perfect time for this, I should first continue to correct and improve the project the union minimum, make it more suitable and more attractive, with some other updates before to want to pay for it, so that it is worth being there and this also before starting the next versions of the project.

So, I finally decided to postpone the transition of the project if possible to Monday, October 3, 2022 (but this time final and permanent date no change possible from now on).

- also I intend to take into consideration the maximum of your feedback and opinions even the critics (apart from those of the level or game design)  for example to change max of prefabricated model, several new playable characters instead of differentiating them by colors, change completely the background of the menu etc, but please note, I do not intend to change the difficulty of the level design or even enhance it,

- if you have other opinions, suggestions, gratifying and constructive advice, do not hesitate,
On this very good evening and see you soon.

Cordially.

Mohammad Trigui.

notes.title: Next evolution of the game and consequences
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As promised, I have thought very carefully about proposing the future of this project and these perspectives and after a decision, I intend to continue very well to support it and maintain it for quite a long time as a kind of game as service.

In this case, there will of course be a lot of Updates, corrections, improvements and so many additions of content to the basic game afterwards, all major and very substantial, for example for version 2.0 and up to version 5.0 of the project (for the moment no date has yet been defined for these updates because each of its updates will require several months of development if not more and also you have to be very patient each time because I I have several projects to do at the same time, including this one), the other news is that the development will probably be done as a team from now on and not just me alone, waiting for confirmation.

So there will be several consequences to this:

- in return for this, the project will unfortunately become paying and this after a few days from now (the project will now become paying from Monday, June 6th exactly) (unfortunately necessary for team development costs throughout this long duration and for full of other previous or subsequent costs) so I invite you all to recover your copy of the game before its conversion into a paid project.

-and even apart from that, there may be a gradual price increase after each very substantial new update in the future.

.With that, good day and see you soon,

Cordially.

Mohammad Trigui.

notes.title: Major update + correction of the majority of the previous defects
notes.content:
[b]Major update version 0.2a available now [/b]

[b]Hello everybody,[/b]

Please excuse me for the deplorable quality of the game since the release of the game last week.

 This is all in the past, please download the brand new version of the game available now as follows:

Uninstall the old version of the game (and especially do not delete the game save files)

Then in the Steam app settings clear the download history.

 If all goes well, the Steam application will restart and you can immediately download the new version of the game.

[b]Nb update:[/b]

I fixed almost the majority of the flaws and bugs in the game.

In addition to further optimizing the game.

And in addition to the visual enhancement of the game.

In short, the game is now playable without any problems from start to finish.

Sorry for the inconvenience and good game to everyone

See you soon .

Cordially .

Mohammad Trigi.
